key_insight: MS-Exam-Gen is a reproducible, source-grounded pipeline for building and auditing a text-only multiple-choice benchmark on multiple sclerosis MRI knowledge for LLM evaluation.
clinical_relevance: It helps test whether biomedical LLMs can handle up-to-date MS-MRI criteria, reporting, monitoring, and mimics without interpreting MRI images directly.
method: Indexed 66 expert sources into 4,289 retrieval chunks
Generated and filtered a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark across 16 topics and 53 subtopics
Applied automated quality audits, same-family consistency screening, and empirical calibration
evidence_signal: Across 12 LLM endpoints, the benchmark produced 36,696 item-level predictions and showed accuracy spanning 89.7% to 46.9% (a 42.8-point range).
watch_item: The benchmark is not clinically certified, and option-order effects plus incomplete expert adjudication mean results should be treated as candidate evaluation data, not a final exam standard.
paper_title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
